BrochureContent.Content:
Property Partners Gill & Glynn are pleased to bring to market this impressive 4 bedroom, contemporary family home, located just 3 kms outside the idyllic village of Cong. Surrounded by lush countryside, Drumsheel is set in one of the most stunning locations in the west of Ireland.

ACCOMADATION

Accommodation extends to 234.41 sq. m. (2,524 sq. ft) and sits on approximately 1.2 acres of private grounds.

The property is accessed through electric gates and opens onto a welcoming entrance hall, with a sweeping staircase and balcony-style upstairs landing. The spacious living room is located to the rear of the property, featuring an electric fireplace with a sleek white mantelpiece. A set of large sliding doors opens onto the gravel driveway at the rear of the property. The living room flows seamlessly into the combined kitchen and dining area. This light-filled space includes white shaker-style cabinetry and a window seat nestled neatly between the kitchen units. There is a built-in double oven and microwave, together with an integrated fridge.

Located just off the kitchen is a large utility room with ample storage, an elevated washing machine and tumble dryer, providing excellent practicality for everyday family life. A second laundry room is located upstairs, also equipped with a washing machine and tumble dryer. A thoughtfully designed laundry chute links the upstairs laundry room directly to the downstairs laundry room, making household chores particularly convenient for busy family living. 

 To the left of the entrance hall is a cosy sitting room. The property also benefits from a generous ground floor bedroom with built-in wardrobes and a Jack and Jill ensuite bathroom, providing access from both the bedroom and the main hall for guests.

The first floor comprises of three spacious bedrooms, all with built-in wardrobes. The master bedroom features a generous walk-in wardrobe and a stylish ensuite bathroom. The bathrooms throughout the home are finished with contemporary floor-to-ceiling tiling, sleek chrome fittings and wet room style showers. The family bathroom is further enhanced by a stylish claw-foot bath.

There is a large walk-in hot press together with additional attic storage, accessed via a Stira staircase from one of the bedrooms.

Combining comfort with efficiency, the home benefits from geothermal under floor heating throughout, with insulation incorporated within the floors, as well as a new heat recovery ventilation system designed toi improve air quality and energy efficiency. The property also benefits from triple-glazed windows and a composite front door, further enhancing the homes thermal performance, comfort and security. Fibre broadband, providing fast and reliable connectivity for work, entertainment and everyday living.

Externally, the property features an impressive stone-clad façade, a gravel driveway that wraps around the house, and a paved patio area. The home is approached through electric entrance gates, enhancing both privacy and security. A detached garage is located to the rear of the property and benefits from substantial 6-inch cavity wall construction, providing excellent insulation and storage potential.

LOCATION

Cong is a village straddling the borders of County Galway and County Mayo. Cong is located on the isthmus connecting Loughs Corrib and Mask, near the towns of Headford and Ballinrobe and the villages of Neale and Cross. It is well known and renowned for many tourist attractions such as Ashford Castle, location of the Quiet Man film, lake cruises and historic sights. The land is just minutes from the popular Ashford Castle and all that Cong has to offer while it is also commuting distance to the bustling city of Galway.
VIEWING
This property is likely to appeal to a wide variety of purchasers and truly must be viewed to be fully appreciated.

An early inspection is highly recommended. In addition to business hours, viewings can usually be accommodated in the evenings and at weekends.

To arrange a viewing, call or text our negotiator handling this sale, Emma Gill, on 087 799 9955 or 091 884000.
